name: Long waist apron
description: A black cotton apron tied at the waist that hangs to the shins, with two pockets for an order pad and a pen.
notes: Folded to 240 mm by 280 mm and 20 mm tall, the waistband at the +z end with cream ties looped back across the top and two patch pockets at the hem. Slot `vest`, as the bib aprons take: no apron slot exists, and a waist apron is worn over the trousers alongside a belt, so `waist` would clash with it. It covers the front of the legs. The `xl` and `xs` sizes share this model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Short waist apron
description: A short cream server's apron on a navy waistband, with a row of three pockets for tips, pens and a notepad.
notes: Folded in half to 250 mm by 150 mm and 8 mm thin, the navy waistband at the +z end with its ties looped back over the top and three pockets along the hem. Box/volume x2.2: the folded block is a flat cloth area the reference packs tighter. Slot `vest`, as the long waist apron explains. The `xl` and `xs` sizes share this model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Witch dress
description: A black costume dress with wide sleeves, purple trim, and its cuffs and hem cut into long points.
notes: Folded to 300 mm by 340 mm and 40 mm tall on `g.jacket`, neck at the +z end: a dark scooped neckline with purple trim, the sleeves folded in along the sides ending in pointed cuffs, and four hem points of uneven length; cuffs and points lie flat on the floor, peeking out past the -z edge as a ragged hem. Box/volume x3.7: the box counts the air between the folded layers and round the flat points. Slot `torso`; as a dress it should also block `legs` once slots can block others. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Long witch dress
description: A heavy black dress that sweeps the floor, with pointed sleeves and a purple drawstring pouch sewn at the hip, big enough for a couple of small bottles.
notes: Folded in a thick bundle, 320 mm by 360 mm and 60 mm tall, built like the witch dress with longer cuff and hem points; the round purple drawstring pouch lies on top, its gathered neck and cream cord towards the collar. Box/volume x3.5: the box counts the air between the folded layers, round the flat points and round the pouch. The pouch is a 1 by 2 grid for small bottles; restricting it to bottles has no content field. Slot `torso`; it should also block `legs` once slots can block others. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Short witch dress
description: A short purple costume dress with black trim, pointed cuffs and a jagged hem above the knee.
notes: Folded to 280 mm by 260 mm and 30 mm tall, built like the witch dress: a dark neckline with black trim, short pointed cuffs and three hem points. Slot `torso`; it should also block `legs` once slots can block others. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wool hoodie
description: A thick knitted wool pullover with a hood and a front pouch pocket. Much warmer than a cotton one.
notes: Folded to 360 mm by 320 mm and 60 mm tall on `g.jacket` with no front opening, neck at the +z end: the hood folded down over the neck with cream drawcords, a kangaroo pocket with grey edges, the sleeves folded in along the sides with grey ribbed cuffs, and a ribbed hem band. Box/volume x3.0: a folded garment's block counts air the reference packs out. Slot `torso`. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Arm warmers
description: A pair of snug knitted tubes worn from wrist to upper arm to keep the arms warm.
notes: Laid flat side by side, each a heather-grey knit tube 380 mm long tapering from 100 mm to 75 mm, with charcoal ribbing at both ends and knit ribs along its length. Box/volume x2.7: the box counts the gap between the two tubes. Slot `arms`, the slot arm guards take: no under-sleeve slot exists, so wearing them under arm guards has to wait for one. The `xl` and `xs` sizes share this model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Belly band
description: A wide tube of soft knitted wool worn around the stomach under a shirt, to keep the middle warm.
notes: Laid flat: a knit wool tube 300 mm wide and 220 mm tall pressed to 14 mm, with rounded folds down both sides, a soft rolled welt at the top and bottom edges and fine knit ribs between. Slot `belly`, the slot the belly band holster named: it sits round the stomach under the shirt alongside a belt and a vest, so neither `torso`, `waist` nor `vest` fits. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
